title: On the desk
intro: A few things in motion, a few ideas for later. Nothing here is a deadline ~

items.title: Month-by-month folders
items.detail: Let older field notes settle into folders while newer ones stay within reach.

items.title: Performance and display pass
items.detail: Chrome is the everyday testing baseline for now. After the visual and folder work, revisit the remaining Firefox/Edge differences, real browser zoom and common display sizes. Targeted transition fixes are in, but the deeper performance pass is not declared solved. Check for regressions, unnecessary work, stale code and security issues.

items.title: Setup editing in place
items.detail: Parked for later, when the device bay needs more attention. Keep Tools and Peripherals simple when bringing their editing into the reading view.

items.title: Quieter ambient rhythms
items.detail: Project traces, log scans, cover glow, NEW chips, weather and seasonal details each have their own rhythm and quiet rests. Same artwork and layout, with text kept still. Hidden and covered effects pause reliably in either Memory State mode.

items.title: Memory State code surface
items.detail: Short code-like sequences respond to actions, with quiet idle passages between them. The one-way stream drops hidden lines while its numbering continues. Legacy Visual stays on the left in Settings; Code Surface sits on the right.

items.title: Timeline arrival
items.detail: A brief register-line and reading-area arrival in both readers. Filtering keeps its place without replaying the entrance, and keyboard focus stays inside the timeline.

items.title: Window control harmony
items.detail: Entry and notebook edit gears sit beside the other window controls, matching Setup. The existing sizes, editing actions and public read-only boundaries stay intact.

items.title: Quieter transition work
items.detail: Opening and closing entries retain the Pages workspace instead of rebuilding it. Fewer overlapping masks and fades, paused hidden effects and safer close/minimize cleanup reduce unnecessary work. Remaining browser differences stay on the desk.

items.title: Bounded notebook retrieval
items.detail: A stalled first request now reaches a retry state instead of waiting indefinitely. Late expired requests cannot overwrite newer notebook data.

items.title: Notebook editing in place
items.detail: A local gear opens editing on the page: change wording, add work and mark it complete. Drafts survive closing the window; saves stay local until published through the bell.

items.title: Dated notebook history
items.detail: Choose completed work, enter a release version and date, then save it into Filed. Older history stays intact and publishing remains a separate action.

items.title: Roomier windows and matching controls
items.detail: Normal entries are wider without changing height or mobile layout. Notebook and entry gears match the close controls, and completed notebook titles have a clearer strike-through in both themes.

items.title: Quote-safe recommendation saves
items.detail: Repeated saves retain quoted recommendation text without accumulating escape characters. The local reader and exported archive agree.

items.title: Desktop proportions and quieter background work
items.detail: Scaled reading labels and section manifests, consistent Archive footer spacing, shared reduced-motion-aware Memory State input, paused covered/offscreen effects and keyboard boundaries for record windows.

items.title: Day, Night and window depth
items.detail: A mineral-gray Day appearance alongside Night and local-clock Auto. Clearer labels, continuous window frames, tactile controls and slimmer entry bars, with permission-aware remembered preferences.

items.title: Startup and notebook settling
items.detail: Boot progress and brief signal interruptions vary between visits without extending startup. The notebook opens with lighter registration details; clicking its header or the Connections header no longer restarts the opening.

items.title: Independent publishing
items.detail: Saved notes publish against the committed site while unfinished visual work stays local. Interrupted publication can recover without sweeping unrelated code into a content update.

items.title: Record closing and winter details
items.detail: Closing dissolves the content before the frame contracts; minimizing keeps its own restore gesture. December and January join the calendar decorations, with seasonal details remaining optional.

items.title: Terminal and window gestures
items.detail: T opens a directory with real section dates and a compact restore icon. Search and Terminal construct their frames before the contents resolve; minimizing contracts toward the restore control without losing reading state. The greeting keeps up with local time and returning tabs.

items.title: Artwork and shortcuts
items.detail: Independent title-background framing for Projects and Games. Press S for a separate web-search bar that opens results in a new tab; Connections holds the public X and Reddit links behind its own signal-acquisition sequence.

items.title: Editing comforts
items.detail: Optional note-heading titles, styled native selectors and clear local save states. Progress labels keep focus while typing; unfinished recommendation and hardware text stays in a local draft when the editor closes. Saving and publishing remain separate.

items.title: System Notices
items.detail: First-visit shortcuts open a quiet reference tray beside minimized windows, then fade away when left alone. Remembered visits respect local-memory permission.

items.title: Settings and startup
items.detail: A square profile welcome and composed workspace arrival. A dedicated palette button controls entry animation, full or quick startup, seasonal details and Terminal or Legacy navigation. Remembered choices respect local-memory permission.

items.title: Section reading space
items.detail: Written project updates, game sessions and a field-note reading desk beside the existing lists.

items.title: A clearer timeline
items.detail: Recent signals grouped by date, with source selection and a more readable trail.

items.title: Editing in place
items.detail: Create, format and edit field notes, games and projects in their own windows. Saves stay local; the publishing bell reviews saved changes and publishes the batch separately from drafts.

items.title: Steam and artwork
items.detail: Automatic Current Game with playtime and achievements when available; adjustable game headers without changing original images.

items.title: Session and Past Logs
items.detail: Keep games to return to separate from completed or retired play logs.

items.title: Full-size media
items.detail: Open samples and screenshots outside the record window.

items.title: Field Archive
items.detail: A file-manager home for older notes, with original writing order preserved.
